QUOTE: Under `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, an unconfigured build fails every allocation with NULL. / default `platform_calloc_uninit` and `platform_free_uninit` ... stubs: calloc returns NULL, free is a no-op
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the uninitialised default stubs make calloc return NULL and free do nothing, rather than falling back to libc.
